name: Creator commission statement
summary: Each month, the finance lead gets a draft statement of what every creator has earned, worked from the store's orders export: commission under the programme's rules, flat fees, amounts carried under the minimum, and a payout list. A person approves it; finance pays.

sources.title: The commission statement in Fully Powered AI's own influencer-marketing capability templates (MIT), rewritten here as a self-contained template that works from exports a person supplies, with its own rules for prepared work: every order placed once, every gap named, and a person who approves and pays.

sources.contribution: Four practices for paying affiliates: commission worked on the order subtotal rather than on shipping and tax, holding a sale through the refund window before it earns, a minimum payout, and setting aside an order whose buyer email is the affiliate's own.
